finding: The original mixed-type correlated C50 controls cannot be assumed to isolate C06 on the standalone C06 branch.
human_readable_explanation: C06 prevents domain elimination from changing the captured key type. That restores the intended type of the outer serialized domain key, but normal decorrelation then preserves a separate equality join between the original mixed numeric types. That inner join can still require C50 to bring matching values into the same task before physical key conversion.

source_trace.contract: Correlated EXISTS/NOT EXISTS builds a domain and final semi/anti domain join. Nullable domains default to typed StablePickle keys, so that final join has String keys on both sides.
C06 requires exactly equal source and captured type annotations before domain elimination may substitute the captured value. With unequal original numeric types, it retains the dependent join.

Fallback pushes the dependent join through its Filter, replaces captured references using the original typed domain, and converts the AddDependencies leaf into Cross(domain, inner). The original equality filter remains.

Later Logical rewrites I and II extract a member equality crossing the Cross inputs, append numeric join keys and change Cross to Inner. These stages follow decorrelation and precede stage assignment.

Standalone C06 does not contain GatherJoinInputs. Regular Grace stage assignment hash-shuffles original input keys; common-type casts are introduced later inside the physical join builder. Thus a String outer-domain join does not prove the preserved inner numeric join is free of C50.

actual_evidence_scope.prior_attribution: Existing C06 explains the typed-domain mismatch at C50. This report qualifies how to verify the fixes independently; it does not withdraw the original failures.

decision.reason: Relabeling unchanged four-node controls as isolated C06 acceptance would conflate two independent correctness fixes.

required_followup: Rerun C06 own existing controls against its standalone exact build receipt.
Retain original C50 correlated failures as qualified integration coverage.

If combined coverage is necessary, explicitly validate C06 plus C50 in a separate integration checkout and bind actual relevant inner/outer join shapes. Do not merge either fix into the other main-based branch.
Do not call a one-node or configuration-changed check an unchanged equivalent of the original four-node profiles.
